newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Airlines sees no ringgit impact.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Airlines sees no ringgit impact.

text.p: Malaysian Airline System Bhd (MAS) said on Thursday it did not see any immediate impact on its revenue and operations from the current weakness of the ringgit against the dollar.
"We do not see a very big impact for the time being...probably we will come out a winner," MAS chairman Tajudin Ramli told reporters after the company's annual general meeting.
MAS's operates Malaysia Airlines, the country's flagship carrier.
Tajudin said the company has hedged its dollar exposure for payments of its new Boeing Co aircraft and that its revenues are in a basket of currencies including the dollar.
He did not specify the breakdown in dollars and other currencies. MAS is taking delivery this year of four of the 25 Boeing aircraft it ordered last year for a total of $4 billion.
Tajudin also said that there would not be an impact in the medium-term for MAS from its debt in various currencies.
Malaysia's ringgit has been sliding against the dollar in the past month, and earlier on Thursday pierced the key 2.65 level. It later recovered slightly to 2.6420/50.
